caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate lidded container, likely a decorative vessel, placed centrally on a plain background. The container is brown in color and features elaborate decorative details. The vessel has two round handles on either side, with floral and medallion-like embellishments on its body. The lid is topped by a sculpted finial consisting of bulbous and leaf patterns, stacked in three tiers, giving a textured appearance. The vessel’s surface is shaded to give a sense of roundness and metallic or ceramic material. Toward the upper left of the background, there is a small, simple horizontal sketch resembling a cigar or tube, with line shading and circular ends, one at each end. The artist's name, "JESSICA PRICE," is lightly inscribed at the lower right corner of the drawing. The entire composition uses warm brown and sepia tones, and the background remains an unadorned beige color.
title: Covered Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
